drafted_from: workflow:tell-when-a-wake-stops's own file, tools/workflows/recipes/tell-when-a-wake-stops.json (its wake, definition and steps), and the engine's wake-failed fact (trillion-rust e9f19e41c).
start_here: Say to your AI: "Tell me when one of my wakes stops." The AI turns on workflow:tell-when-a-wake-stops's wake a-wake-stopped. From then on, each wake that stops is told to you with its cause, and switching it off and on again resumes it.
no_lists_because: It keeps nothing and reads nothing: the wake-failed fact carries the tool, the wake and the cause, and the run tells one notice.
instructions: 1. Turn on this workflow's wake a-wake-stopped. The engine keeps a wake-failed fact whenever a wake turns failed.
2. Read each notice that comes: its title names the tool, the wake and the cause; switch that wake off and on to resume it.
3. Read the answer: a notice says what stopped and why; once you have fixed the cause, switch the wake off and then on again, and read wake:list until it shows the wake running.
